initialization: Actor/target, Critic/target and Critic optimizer from fixed final T161. Actor optimizer reset in both arms. Parent replay retained, RNG reset to shared declared seed. Explicit warm start; not complete resume.
objective: normalized TD3 Q objective plus fixed T161 action retention at all six T159 successful trajectory state banks
reward: unchanged T148 native reward + T59 clearance penalty + T66 progress bonus
study_type: one-training-seed paired local gamma sensitivity pilot; not from-scratch algorithm ranking
reference_limit: inspired by Q-scale normalization and policy regularization; online frozen-policy retention is not an exact TD3+BC reproduction
post_training_gate: Evaluate both final-budget candidates against common T161 parent and preserved T159 on all eight fixed tasks; no automatic promotion
comparison: Only gamma differs between arms; shared initial weights/replay, seed, update budget, rewards, tasks and action interface
limitation: Warm-start Critic learned at gamma=.99. Contrast includes adaptation to changed return semantics; verify from-scratch with multiple seeds before causal general claims.
